description: Requests carrier registration for the workspace’s toll-free number. In the current API, this returns submit_in_dashboard with setup_url. The person submits in Settings, Text messaging, where they choose a number on the first submission and enter their business registration number. Review the saved form with sms_setup_status and obtain the person’s approval before passing confirm: true. Requires API key scope: account.

phone_number.description: First submission only: the toll-free number the person picked, E.164 (+18335550100).

name: sms_registration_submit
title: Submit the texting registration
